answer: Bind each identity to one registered arborist practice: a certified tree surgeon, publicly registered, jobs logged with geotagged client-signed photos. One practice backs one identity; a second claim on the same arborist fails. Climbs are filed under the lone-worker signal beacon, so an absent arborist cannot fake a cedar job. Each fake costs one real arborist, 1,400 units, 120 days; 100 fakes cost 140,000 units, 12,000 days. Cheapest cheat: hiring a stand-in climber, who burns their own practice; a forged certificate fails the register, and a river-bank spot check exposes the stand-in.
